name: FORGE
features: Account sign-in recovery for blocked Android Google popups with redirect fallback
Safe access to previously saved device data only after Firebase authenticates the matching account and a saved profile exists
Explicit cached-cloud waiting state and cloud conflict re-verification
Actionable sign-in failure messaging and safe cache-only refresh without clearing private records
Additional regression tests verifying cross-account isolation and onboarding guard
Preserve v59 measurement trends, saved workouts, food logs, account-specific IndexedDB photos and graphite/lime visuals
